Creates a new ClientConfiguration instance configured to a single host given InetSocketAddress. For example given the endpoint http://localhost:9200 
ClientConfiguration configuration = ClientConfiguration
                .create(InetSocketAddress.createUnresolved("localhost", 9200));
items.translation:
创建一个新的 ClientConfiguration 实例，该实例针对单个主机进行配置，并给定一个 InetSocketAddress。例如，给定端点 http://localhost:9200

                .create(InetSocketAddress.createUnresolved("localhost", 9200));

items.source:
Creates a new ClientConfiguration instance configured to a single host given hostAndPort. For example given the endpoint http://localhost:9200 
ClientConfiguration configuration = ClientConfiguration.create("localhost:9200");
Returns the SSLContext to use. Can be Optional.empty() if not configured.
items.translation: 返回要使用的SSLContext。如果未配置，则可以是Optional.empty()。

items.source: Returns the HostnameVerifier to use. Must be Optional.empty() if not configured. Cannot be used with the Rest5Client used from Elasticsearch 9 on as the underlying Apache http components 5 does not offer a way to set this. Users that need a hostname verifier must integrate this in a SSLContext. Returning a value here is ignored in this case
items.translation: 返回要使用的 HostnameVerifier。如果未配置，必须为 Optional.empty()。 无法与 Elasticsearch 9 及更高版本中使用的 Rest5Client 一起使用，因为其底层的 Apache HTTP 组件 5 不提供设置此选项的方法。需要主机名验证器的用户必须在 SSLContext 中集成此功能。在这种情况下，在此处返回值将被忽略。
